Short title and commencement

GOVERNOR'S POWERS ORDER, 2000
GOVERNOR'S POWERS
ORDER, 2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE ORDER
11 OF 2000
An Order to
provide for powers of the Governor of a Province to make, promulgate and issue
the Ordinances and other legal instruments
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th November, 2000]
No. 2-10/99-Min-1, dated
20-11-2000.---Whereas it is expedient provide for the powers of the
Governor of a Province to make, promulgate and issue the Ordinances and other
legal instruments;
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This order may be called the Governor's Powers Order,
2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

GOVERNOR'S POWERS ORDER, 2000
GOVERNOR'S POWERS
ORDER, 2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE ORDER
11 OF 2000
An Order to
provide for powers of the Governor of a Province to make, promulgate and issue
the Ordinances and other legal instruments
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th November, 2000]
No. 2-10/99-Min-1, dated
20-11-2000.---Whereas it is expedient provide for the powers of the
Governor of a Province to make, promulgate and issue the Ordinances and other
legal instruments;
2. Amendment of Article 4,
Chief Executive's Order 9 of 1999.---In the Provisional Constitution
(Amendment) Order No.9 of 1999, in Article 4---
(a) the words
"on instructions of the Chief Executive" shall be omitted; and
(b) for the full
stop at the end, a colon shall be substituted and thereafter the following
provisos shall be added, namely:--
"Provided that it shall be
the duty of the Governor to furnish information relating to any proposed
Ordinance to the Chief Executive: -
Provided further that the Chief
Executive may at any time, whether before or after promulgation of an Ordinance
by the Governor, issue directions or instructions to the Governor including
those to amend, alter or repeal an Ordinance, as the Chief Executive may deem
fit."
